```{r}
#| tbl-cap: MPX NYC popular residential neighborhoods
#| label: tbl-home-map

table_data <- make_tabledata_residence()

labelled::var_label(table_data$neighborhood) <- "Neighborhood"
labelled::var_label(table_data$community) <- "Community district"
labelled::var_label(table_data$borough) <- "Borough"
labelled::var_label(table_data$count) <- "Count of participants"
labelled::var_label(table_data$proportion) <- "Proportion of participants"

 table_data |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::filter(count > 29) |>
   dplyr::select(neighborhood, community, borough, count, proportion) |>
  gt::gt() |>
     gt::tab_header(
    title = "Most popular neighborhoods for primary residence",
    subtitle = "MPX NYC 2022"
  ) |>
   gt::fmt_percent(proportion, decimals = 0)

```
